role: The beacon: a tile-entity block whose GUI consumes effect payments, and whose tile entity recomputes the pyramid levels every 80 ticks and pushes a beam.
scope_reason: world.conf beacon = off: WorldConf.beacon gates BlockBeacon.onBlockActivated, so no player ever opens the GUI or pays for effects. The block and its tile entity exist (SPEC keeps the block, using it does nothing).

notes: The tile entity is fully present in the native engine: tileentity.c carries the NBT (Levels, Primary, Secondary), tileticks.c:389 runs func_146003_y's pyramid scan every 80th tick with world_can_block_see_the_sky, and render_blocks3.c:1983 draws the block. world-daynight-s1 covers the tile-entity tick family it belongs to. lane/itemuse: iu-off-s1 uses it with world.conf's switch off (right-clicked with dirt, empty-handed and sneaking: the dirt is placed against it, nothing opens).
